qualification: HostOnly prepared-and-admitted dedicated first-order source; runtime and semantic correspondence unobserved

grammar.binding: lexical variables; closed entry; immutable source-ordered global named function table
grammar.named_calls: first declaration lookup; self and mutual recursion remain calls, without source-recursion unrolling
grammar.matching: first matching source arm; ordered binders; scrutinee evaluated once by the selected execution semantics
grammar.evaluation_order: strict left-to-right operands, arguments and constructor fields
grammar.higher_order_closures: extension; unsupported by this source grammar
grammar.letrec: extension; unsupported by this source grammar
grammar.generic_nominal_adts: separate declaration/constructor extension; not supplied by dedicated List/Tree sorts

numeric_domains.UInt: UInt128 integers in [0,340282366920938463463374607431768211455]; checked add/sub/mul; no modular wrap
numeric_domains.Tree: finite immutable binary Tree with UInt128 leaf payloads
numeric_domains.equality: structural over the dedicated value sum; different variants compare false

schedule.counters: consumed_work includes charged helper work; helper_work, helper_visits and reference_cursor remain distinct
schedule.reference_comparison: sherlock-k-a/1 keeps pure helpers unmetered; equal A/B fuel and runtime correspondence are not claimed
schedule.physical_resources: host heap/stack/time, circuit rows/degree and proof/target costs are unmeasured

extents.status: caller-declared logical capacities and preprocessing extents; no global H1 or output-serialization bound is certified
extents.serialization_scope: bounds.serialization_bytes is the declared owner image/checkpoint capacity; public report JSON size and encoding costs are not measured or enforced by this metadata
extents.frame_scope: bounds.frames is logical image capacity; stack is the separately supplied logical run stack limit
extents.work_scope: max_reference_work, max_helper_work and step_cap are separate logical capacities; fuel is the separately supplied run budget

admission_scope.source_typecheck: all function bodies and entry are checked for lexical variables, signatures and sorts under max_type_depth; calls inspect signatures without recursive callee descent
admission_scope.owner_closed_body_admission: explicit implementation work remains; this report adds no whole-program owner admission checker
admission_scope.unique_function_admission: explicit implementation work remains; first declaration lookup is preserved, not a unique-name guarantee
admission_scope.finance: Absent; transfers, fees, liabilities, wait and resume are outside this dedicated pure grammar

dispositions.supported: the listed dedicated grammar under the selected caller-supplied profile and extents; this artifact is prepared/admitted only
dispositions.tooling_boundary: owner tooling failures retain their locator when supplied, and remain outside runtime Outcome; unsupported source syntax may instead be a located parse diagnostic
dispositions.runtime_boundary: Rejected(error4) frame refusal and Exhausted(kind) runtime limits are not AdmissionRejected, CapacityNotAdmitted or tooling UnsupportedFeature
dispositions.host_violation: separate owner invariant/observation failure; never a successful application outcome
dispositions.native_export: unsupported; witness and constraint plans missing; no native or target result
